findings.evidence: The reduce media query at lines 575-577 excludes .deck-root and all descendants. The actual deck root uses that class (275), cards select animated entrances (310-313), the applicant heading uses deck-wordart (328), and the quorum prompt uses deck-pulse (348). CSS defines infinite shimmer (539-540) and pulse (565-566), plus fly/spin/swoosh entrances (522-531). Thus the public instrument reduced-motion test does not cover the deck exception.
findings.userImpact: Operators or viewers requesting reduced motion still receive decorative motion around applicant names and decision information, potentially impairing comfort and sustained factual reading during deliberation.
findings.suggestedFix: Include the deck in reduced-motion suppression, keeping applicant facts and outcome states immediately visible. Verify computed animation/transition suppression on the actual deck with reduced motion enabled, including card changes and reveal states.

notVerified: No screen-reader session, full keyboard-only task completion, zoom/reflow or forced-colors evaluation was supplied or performed; source semantics do not establish announcement quality or user success.
